title: Insect Explorer ABC
hook: Name each tiny clue with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool insect explorer storybook, friendly field-guide aesthetic, bright garden palette, isolated specimens

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: tiny-world observer with a magnifying glass
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses tiny rhythmic detail—wing, leg, body, web or life-stage clues—while preserving clear target diction.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 leaves a clean recall gap, then confirms with an object-conditioned gesture: ant six-step crawl, flea/grasshopper/leafhopper hop, mantis folded grasping forelegs, beetle wing-cover shell, butterfly/moth wing-open, orb-weaver web circle, pill-bug curl, stick-insect twig freeze, firefly glow, or other visible clue. Do not reduce the whole section to generic antenna/crawl motions.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a tiny parade snare-brush tap plus bright marimba step after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a tiny parade snare-brush tap plus bright marimba step after the target
